answer: Field check-ins: each epoch the protocol picks a random vertex of a public map grid within 20 km of every identity's declared home cell. The identity must visit it within two days and photograph a card that a randomly chosen nearby established member left there, showing a code written in a stated pigment colour. That checker confirms code and colour. Every extra fake needs its own trip to a different point, so one person cannot cheaply keep fifty alive. Limit: members on a remote mesa or with limited mobility need an alternative check.
